mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1200K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to lowered borrowing costs.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 5.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) shows a concurrent 3-month average increase of over 200K jobs, the combined signal of a strong labor market predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over a quarter, signaling strengthened supply chains, is followed by positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturers' increased output boosts economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant positive correlation (p > 0.1) between INDPRO quarterly increases and subsequent SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeding 3% on a yearly basis, indicating strong aggregate demand, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as increased economic activity boosts corporate earnings.
evidence_refs: fact:GDP growth and historical stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly correlated (p > 0.05) with GDPC1 yearly growth rates in triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points within a quarter, signaling a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as reduced borrowing costs stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant increase (p > 0.1) in SPX returns following FEDFUNDS decreases in triggered quarters.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in both payroll employment (PAYEMS) by over 150K jobs and a drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6%, signaling a robust labor market, predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:combined labor indicators and short-term market reactions
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) than in non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) increasing by more than 5% on a yearly basis, indicating strong consumer spending, is followed by positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased demand boosts economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows a negative correlation (p < 0.05) between RSAFS yearly growth and subsequent SPX returns in triggered periods.
